def snap(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    # wire tip: rightmost w/g cell in rows 20-40, col>16
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.splitlines()]
    tip=None
    for r in range(12,45):
        for c in range(49,16,-1):
            if g[r][c] in 'wg':
                tip=(r,c); break
        if tip: break
    # piece top: first M in col 11
    pt=None
    for r in range(10,45):
        if g[r][11]=='M': pt=r; break
    return out, tip, pt

def snap(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    # wire tip: rightmost w/g cell in rows 20-40, col>16
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.splitlines()]
    tip=None
    for r in range(12,45):
        for c in range(49,16,-1):
            if g[r][c] in 'wg':
                tip=(r,c); break
        if tip: break
    # piece top: first M in col 11
    pt=None
    for r in range(10,45):
        if g[r][11]=='M': pt=r; break
    return out, tip, pt
